study.question: Conditional on the inherited model and its supplied-order compression, does the click-AUC recovery from protecting the two greatest-index full summary blocks require their relative block ranks, their within-block event ranks, or chiefly membership in that two-block region?
study.hypothesis: The latest equal-anchor-count contrast leaves terminal-region membership confounded with internal order. A working hypothesis is that much of the newest-two advantage reflects membership in that region: removing only the pair rank while preserving its event sets will cost less than0.0003 validation click AUC, smaller than the observed0.00060315 advantage over the one-newest bridge. Within-block order may provide a separate or interacting contribution and is crossed as a factor. This is a conditional supplied-index hypothesis, not an elapsed-time claim, new architecture priority claim, or whole-history invariance claim.

study.proposed_difference: Add two boolean candidate-only switches: terminal_pair_shuffle and terminal_within_shuffle. Select up to two greatest-index fully valid10-event blocks. The first switch uniformly permutes these blocks as complete tuples; the second permutes complete events separately within these blocks. Compose with the same inherited shuffle of all remaining full blocks. No event crosses the selected-region boundary; original10-event grouping, padding and nonfull blocks survive. Every cell builds all factorial maps from exactly the same100 local plus10 block priorities. Only the five-summary event view is gathered; compression keeps native event identities and task memberships.
predictions: A00 should reproduce parent click AUC0.6684321265491402 at the frozen seed, with unchanged32192421 parameters. Check bridge forward/backward/RNG parity before treating a departure as scientific evidence.
The working membership hypothesis predicts A00-A10<0.0003 and A01-A11<0.0003 click AUC. Use uncertainty to distinguish unresolved differences from practical equivalence.
If local event rank is useful in this region, A00>A01 and/or A10>A11 after matched retraining. If the two scales interact, the corresponding conditional effects differ.

Pair treatment is identity when fewer than two full blocks exist. The local treatment is identity when no full block exists. At a fixed model state these rows must have unchanged predictions for the corresponding switch; separately trained models need not match on these rows.

Among rows with two selected blocks, pair randomization should swap approximately half; local randomization should move approximately90percent of selected event positions in expectation. Report actual denominators and movement, not an unconditional claim.

All learned parameter counts must match; both treatment factors add index overhead equally to every cell. Measured runtime, peak memory, throughput and latency determine cost, not nominal parameter equality.
falsifiers: Effective pair-rank removal with a reproducible click-AUC loss>=0.0003 falsifies the working membership-sufficiency tolerance for this model/summary path.
A resolved within-block penalty rejects a stronger claim that only the selected-region event collection matters; a joint penalty alone requires the factorial conditional contrasts to attribute it.

An identity or ineffective treatment, broken event/membership association, changed padding/target or training RNG, unequal learned capacity, or failed bridge invalidates the comparison rather than falsifying an order mechanism.
Single-seed point differences or absent optional diagnostics cannot establish equivalence, significance, repeated support, a whole-history mechanism, or novelty.
